findings.trigger: After possible helper entry, a live owned child's kill() emits error synchronously. The installed error listener re-enters stop() before any stopping guard, repeatedly signalling until stack exhaustion.
findings.rationale: LFP-05 requires bounded failure handling and exact owned-child cancellation. Set termination-attempt ownership before signalling, arm the close bound independently, and preserve uncertainty without recursive or repeated signals.
findings.oracle: Add a controlled child that synchronously emits a termination error and returns false from kill. Require exactly one owned signal attempt, bounded settlement, and outcome_unknown after possible entry. Keep all prior assertions.

findings.rationale: Canonicalize each new provider/native fixture directory before creating owners and targets. Preserve production containment. This corrects new fixture reachability; the pre-existing production lexical-root limitation is not represented as fixed.
